subject: 리딩파워 유형편 완성
title: 최저 임금법의 필요성
fullPassage: Historical evidence points to workers being exploited by employers in the absence of appropriate laws. This means that workers are not always compensated for the contributions for their increased productivity ― as economic theory would suggest. Employers will be able to exploit workers if they are not legally controlled. Thus, the minimum wage laws may be the only way to prevent many employees from working at wages that are below the poverty line. This point of view means that minimum wage laws are a source of correcting for existing market failure, enhancing the power of markets to create efficient results.
